title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Wolf Trap, Vienna | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Filene Center, part of the Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Vienna, Virginia, USA, on 11 August 2019.

It was the 20th show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019, and the second of two consecutive nights in Vienna.

Starr had previously performed at the Wolf Trap on 17 July 1995, 21 May 1997, 30 May 2000, and 12 June 2014. He returned there on 17 June 2025.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
